prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square advertising poster for a Viettel football weekly package promoting a CR7-style match night. Centerpiece is a photoreal red number 7 football player captured from behind and mid-kick on a stadium field. Include the exact visible text 'BỀN BỈ KHÔNG DỪNG', 'TỐI NAY CHỜ CR7 NỔ SÚNG', 'SOẠN DK CUP7 gửi 1331', and 'XEM WORLD CUP MƯỢT TỪNG PHA TRÊN TV360'. Background is a sunlit or floodlit football stadium with green grass and blurred stands. Surrounding elements: Viettel telecom logo in the top right, a sweeping multicolor ribbon across the lower-left to lower-right area, and an official-style football near the ribbon on the right. Technical style: photoreal sports advertising composite, bright stadium sports lighting, crisp field contrast and motion energy, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
